note: Plans sold before requests existed carry no request id; an approval made by an older panel version must still be found as already done
The member app must show the same answer and the same last day as the panel
A renewal for a member who already owes; a 1-day and a 365-day pause ('A pause can be 1 to 365 days.')
The renewal's start comes from 'today' and the plan's last day; a pause whose dates are already past is still added in full
Two writes in a row (the plan, then the server's approval): a stop between them is mended by pressing Approve again (planRequests.ts:136-139, 162-163)
The card's words are fixed English strings (planRequests.ts:229-243); the member's notification depends on their phone's alert permission
